_doc: The one recipe for the base A exact-stack draw (A2). Every exact_stack script loads this file; nothing below is typed from memory. Each factor's source and status (VERIFIED in a primary record, INFERRED, or UNVERIFIED) is in out/main/auditbench/nullext/exact_stack_20261114/REGISTRATION.md, section 'Base A's stack'.
label: idt-exact-stack-a2
seed_note: Engine-level seed LLM(seed=seed_from_label(seed_label)), as base A used seed_from_label('auditbench-collect') = 797178342 (collect.log non-default args). No per-request SamplingParams.seed: in vLLM 0.26.0 a per-request generator sends sampling to the PyTorch-native path instead of FlashInfer (vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_sampler.py forward_cuda, read in the 0.26.0 sdist). The per-row label '<seed_label>|<prompt_id>|<s>' is written into each row as an identifier only.

engine.torch_note: Installed from the cu128 index BEFORE vLLM, unless the env already holds exactly 2.11.0+cu128; vllm 0.26.0 pins torch==2.11.0, which 2.11.0+cu128 satisfies, so pip keeps it. Base A's build is INFERRED: its import without the cu13 library path failed on libcudart.so.13 (vllm_install.log), which a cu130 torch would have loaded at import. NCCL 2.28.9 is the pin of both builds and does not decide.
engine.pins_note: vllm 0.26.0 was the newest vllm on PyPI on 2026-08-03 (0.27.0 came 2026-08-10); transformers 5.14.1 and tokenizers 0.23.1 were the newest on that day; flashinfer-python==0.6.14 and torch==2.11.0 are vllm 0.26.0's own pins.
engine.env_note: Base A ran /venv/main/bin/python 3.12 (collect.log paths). If the image's /venv/main is not 3.12, box_runner.sh builds /venv/es312 with uv (python 3.12) and records the deviation.
engine.llm_kwargs_note: tensor_parallel_size comes from inputs/box_choice.json (the launcher's choice: 4 is base A's, 2 a recorded deviation).
fatal_if_missing_log_lines: Using FlashInfer for top-p & top-k sampling.
Chunked prefill is enabled with max_num_batched_tokens=16384.
engine.recorded_note: Base A (TP4) and the 2026-08-04 third_party_politics run (TP2, same engine and code) logged these; a different line is a recorded deviation, not a stop.

sampling.expected_completion_tokens_source: base A's 3,456 replies re-encoded with the Llama-3.3 tokenizer (inputs/llama33_tokenizer), mean 399.8
sampling.submission: one LLM.generate call over all 216 cells (SUBMISSION_CHUNK 256 > 216), lora_request=None, use_tqdm=False; text = completion.text.rstrip()
sampling.prompt: tokenizer.apply_chat_template([system prism4, user], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) passed as a text prompt; vLLM 0.26.0 tokenizes it with add_special_tokens=True (renderers/base.py default_cmpl_tok_params; tokenizer(prompt, add_special_tokens=True) at renderers/base.py:481), on top of the template's own <|begin_of_text|>

box.tier_rule: The first tier (tp4, base A's size) with any offer projecting <= job_cap_usd wins; within a tier the card base A's log matches by name first ('H200' before 'H200 NVL'), then the cheapest projection. tp2 is used only when no tp4 offer fits the cap.

phase_minutes._source: create-to-ready 0.98 measured (box 58284750, tmp/nullext_launch.log), budgeted 2.0; vLLM 0.26.0 install has no timed record, budgeted 8.0 (vLLM 0.11.0 took 2.85, idt-r2-nullext provision_local.log), overlapped with the weight fetch at the offer's own inet_down; engine init 4.30 at TP4 (base A collect.log 23:52:06 to 23:56:24) and 5.93 at TP2 (third_party_politics tpp_collect.log 12:10:38 to 12:16:34, vLLM 0.26.0, same code); sampling at TP4 22.52 (base A, 3,456 replies, 1,381,765 completion tokens, 1,023 tokens/s) and at TP2 48.05 (base A's 1,381,765 tokens at the 479 tokens/s of the TP2 third_party_politics base arm, 441,408 tokens in 921 s); capture to destroy 1.9 measured (box 58284750), budgeted 5.0. The go/no-go projection multiplies sampling by sampling_contingency.
